welcome: A little closer to feeling at home.
welcomeBody: Your university, your next step, your everyday Korea. All together in one thoughtful space.
name: Name
aiConsent: Allow relevant study, visa and language context to be sent to the configured AI/search providers
deleteConfirm: Permanently delete this account and its stored data?
privacyNote: Only your name and university are required here. Optional dates and immigration details personalize your dashboard. Never enter passport or residence-card numbers. AI receives only study, visa type and language context with your consent.
askBody: A little guidance for your next big step.
addVisa: Add your visa date for reminders
emptyWebsites: Your everyday links, in one place. Add your first website.
manualOnly: Manual open only · automatic checking unavailable
aiIntro: Ask about campus, Korean, or daily life. Policy answers require current official evidence.
excerptOnly: Search excerpt only — not independently verified
aiSetup: Live AI needs a server API key. Without it, no answer is generated.
questionID: Where can I get my student ID?
questionVisa: How do I extend my visa?
questionWork: Can international students work part time?
practiceNote: Introductory curriculum: 12 lessons. Advanced levels currently receive review suggestions, not a full advanced curriculum.
immigrationWarning: General educational overview, not individual legal advice. Current requirements have not been verified. Confirm your specific category with immigration before acting.
notVerified: Not verified against current official policy
checklistWarning: Illustrative planning checklist only. These items are not an official required-document list and may not apply to your case.
reminderNote: Reminders are calculated when you open the app. No background push notifications are sent.
noUpdates: You’re all caught up. No matching updates.
offline: Offline — public lessons are available; account changes require a connection.
error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
privacyBody: Profiles and progress are stored in the local server database. Chat is held in memory in this browser tab. AI requests are sent only when you enable consent and submit a question. Sign out on shared devices. No advertising trackers are included.
jobsWarning: Check your visa conditions and required work permission before starting employment. A listing is not proof that a job is permitted.
emergencyWarning: Directory entries below require official/current verification before production. For a medical emergency, use the emergency ambulance line rather than a general health information line.
offlineGuide: Setup guide, not a live AI answer
dataNotice: Content language: English/Korean. Navigation supports 10 languages; untranslated extended text falls back to English.
profileRequired: Tell us a little about your Korea.
needConsent: Enable AI consent in Profile first.
speechUnavailable: Korean speech is unavailable on this device. Try a browser with a Korean voice installed.
contentDisclaimer: Official links are directory starting points, not verified process instructions.
offlineSaved: Only public learning content is cached on this device.
progressNote: Scores use the latest saved attempt per lesson.
passwordHint: Use at least 10 characters. No email verification or password reset service is configured.
checkComplete: All done for today. Your progress is saved.
